title: Mark a shipment delivered
body:
Drivers' handhelds need to report a delivery.

Add `mark_delivered(shipment_id)` to `parcelo/shipments.py`. It sets the shipment status to "delivered", sets `delivered_at` to the time of delivery, and returns the shipment.

Marking a shipment that does not exist must fail. Marking one that is cancelled or already delivered must fail too.
